items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: He didn't have the strong sound of Hodges or Bird or Benny Carter, like that.

ctx.x: Well, before you go to Buster Smith and Basie, what about Buster Smith as a soloist? Was he a big improvising man himself?
He was a great improviser. He didn't have the strong sound of Hodges or Bird or Benny Carter, like that. He had a soft alto sound, but he was very good as a lead instrument.
Was it more like Hilton Jefferson, or --
